chunks: He, peace be upon him, was asked about Laylat al-Qadr, so he said:

On it, the angels and the scribes descend to the lowest heaven, and they write what will occur in the affair of the year and what will befall the servants. And there is a matter with Him, Mighty and Majestic, held in abeyance, in which belongs to Him the will; so He brings forward from it what He wills, and delays from it what He wills, and He effaces
and establishes, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.

key_terms.أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ: the Mother of the Book, the ultimate source with Allah
key_terms.السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا: the lowest heaven to which they descend
key_terms.الْكَتَبَةُ: the scribes who record what will occur
key_terms.الْمَشِيئَةُ: the divine will by which Allah advances or delays matters
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةُ: the angels who descend on that night
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ: Laylat al-Qadr, the Night of Decree in which the affairs of the year are set down
key_terms.يَمْحُو: He effaces or removes what He wills from the decree
key_terms.يُثْبِتُ: He confirms or establishes what He wills

ai.seo_question: What happens on Laylat al-Qadr according to Imam عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that on Laylat al-Qadr, the angels descend and the events of the coming year are written concerning what will happen to the servants. It also states that ultimate authority remains with Allah, Who effaces and establishes whatever He wills, while the ultimate source of decree remains with Him in Umm al-Kitab.
